6,915 likes, 873 comments - jockofuel on October 23, 2026: "Their next big WIN starts with a small daily habit.

Join Chris Pratt and Jocko Willink for Jocko Fuel’s Warrior Kid Challenge, a FREE 30-day family challenge built around five habits that help kids build confidence, discipline, and character.

Starting October 26, get moving, read, learn, and build healthy habits alongside your kids. You’ll get a printable habit tracker, the Warrior Kid Code, and weekly guidance from Chris and Jocko to help your family along the way.

Then celebrate together with Way of the Warrior Kid, streaming November 25 on Apple TV.

Let’s see what your family can do. Comment “WKC” to sign up TODAY.".
